instructions_en: Listen to four people and match each speaker with the information that best describes them.
instructions_vi: Nghe bốn người và ghép mỗi người với thông tin phù hợp.

audio.transcript: Speaker 1: I used to buy a drink in a new plastic bottle every day. Now I carry the same bottle and a food box, so I throw much less away. Speaker 2: I have tried running on my own, but I stop after a week. A class works better because other people keep me motivated. Speaker 3: I rarely use my laptop for entertainment. Most of my time online is spent finding articles and finishing assignments. Speaker 4: Online shops are convenient, but I still like going to local stores because I can compare products and ask questions before I buy.
